en: Specifies whether to auto-fetch the repository while the _Commit Graph_ is in view. The interval is controlled by the built-in `#git.autofetchPeriod#` setting. If `#git.autofetch#` is enabled, VS Code handles auto-fetching and this setting has no effect.
Specifies the location of the details panel in the _Commit Graph_
Show the details panel to the right of the Commit Graph
Show the details panel below the Commit Graph
Specifies which editor group editors (files, diffs, etc.) opened from the _Commit Graph_ should appear in when the graph is in an editor tab. Has no effect when the graph is shown as a panel.

Always opens editors in the active editor group
Disallows selecting multiple commits
Allows selecting multiple commits without restriction

Specifies whether to reverse the minimap orientation in the _Commit Graph_ so that older commits appear on the left and newer commits on the right
Specifies whether the _Commit Graph_ sidebar is pinned. When pinned, the sidebar shares space with the graph; when unpinned, the sidebar floats over the graph and auto-collapses when it loses focus

Shows only branches associated with active agents (running or idle less than 24 hours)
Specifies which row to select by default in the _Commit Graph_
Selects the "Work in progress" (WIP) row
Selects the HEAD row
e.g. July 25th, 2018 7:18pm
Specifies whether to show a sticky timeline header that remains visible at the top while scrolling in the _Commit Graph_

Specifies whether to show inline working tree change stats on every worktree's _WIP_ row in the _Commit Graph_. When disabled, only the primary worktree's _WIP_ row and the currently-selected worktree's _WIP_ row show stats — which avoids an initial `git status` per worktree as rows scroll into view in large graphs
(Experimental) Specifies whether to enable the Agent Kanban mode on the _Commit Graph_

(Experimental) Specifies whether to enable the Treemap visualization modes (Files, Commits, Agent Activity) alongside the Visual History timeline on the _Commit Graph_. When disabled, only the timeline visualization is available.
